rung_purposes.purpose: Initialize test parameters: fill target (D122), max leak drop (D120), overpressure limit (D123).
Detect pressure transmitter PT-2001 wire break / under-range (< -5.0 kPa) and activate alarm M292.
Detect pack overpressure condition (> D123) and latch overpressure alarm M291.
Latch low supply air alarm M293 if supply pressure switch X22 is lost during test cycle.
Reset latched alarms (fill timeout, overpressure, supply air) on fault reset pushbutton X1.
Energize fault beacon Y25 and common fault flag M299 on any active fault or E-stop trip.
Manual vent valve control via PB-2010 (X25) when auto mode selector X2 is OFF.
Start test cycle on pallet arrival (X23) in Auto without faults; clear prior pass/fail results.
Transition from Clamping (M201) to Filling (M202) once clamp closed switch X20 is confirmed.
Run 8.0 s fill timeout timer T21 while in Filling step M202.
Latch fill timeout alarm M290 if fill step timer T21 expires.
Transition from Filling (M202) to Stabilise (M203) when pack pressure reaches threshold D122.
Run 5.0 s stabilization timer T22 during Stabilise step M203.
Store initial pack pressure D110 from D100 on rising edge of timer T23.
Transition from Stabilise (M203) to Leak Test (M204) upon completion of timer T22.
Run 10.0 s leak test measurement timer T23 during step M204.
Record final pressure D111 and calculate pressure drop D112 (D110 - D111) when T23 expires.
Evaluate leak rate against limit D120 at end of test; latch PASS (M210) or FAIL (M211).
Transition from Leak Test (M204) to Vent (M205) upon expiration of test timer T23.
Abort active cycle on fault: reset active steps, latch FAIL (M211), and jump to Vent (M205).
Run vent timer T200 (5.0 s on FX5) during Vent step M205.
Transition from Vent (M205) to Unclamp (M206) when T200 completes and pressure is safe (< 1.0 kPa).
Transition from Unclamp (M206) to Complete (M207) once clamp open LS X21 is confirmed.
Clear Complete step M207 and busy flag M200 after pallet leaves station (X23 drops).
Energize clamp close solenoid Y20 during clamping, filling, testing, and venting steps.
Energize fill valve Y21 during Fill step M202 if no common fault M299 exists.
Energize vent valve Y22 during Vent step M205 or upon overpressure alarm M291.
Output test result PASS (Y23) or FAIL (Y24) to line controller in Complete step M207.
End of PLC scan execution.
